title: GPT-6 Astra Cites Brand Sites 71% of the Time. No ChatGPT Model Has Gone Higher.
summary: GPT-6 Astra cites brand sites 71% of the time, the highest of any ChatGPT model. It also dropped structured citations, so many AEO tools now read zero.
body_markdown:
[Tarsh Swarnkar](https://writesonic.com/blog/author/tarsh-swarnkar)


Data & Infrastructure @ Writesonic


Tarsh builds the data pipelines behind Writesonic's AI visibility research, including the AI Ads Index. His work focuses on real-time measurement of how AI platforms cite, mention, and rank brands.


[Tanay](https://writesonic.com/blog/author/tanay)


Growth Marketer


Tanay covers the intersection of AI and marketing at Writesonic.
His work focuses on how LLMs and AI Agents are reshaping search, and how marketing teams can adapt their SEO and content strategies for an AI-first search landscape.
